<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="de">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Oskar Marketing | Affiliate Academy</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bebas+Neue&family=DM+Sans:wght@300;400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
:root{--bg:#0A1F44;--surface:#0f1f3d;--surface2:#162844;--border:#1c3060;--border2:#243870;--accent:#C6A75E;--green:#0F7B45;--text:#f0f0f0;--muted2:#778}
body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;min-height:100vh;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;padding:52px 20px 80px}
.wrap{width:100%;max-width:390px;animation:rise 0.8s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both}
@keyframes rise{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(28px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
.logo-wrap{display:flex;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:20px}
.logo-img{width:110px;height:110px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;border:2px solid rgba(198,167,94,0.5);box-shadow:0 0 25px rgba(198,167,94,0.2);animation:spin 8s linear infinite}
@keyframes spin{from{transform:rotate(0deg)}to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.profile{text-align:center;margin-bottom:36px}
.handle{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted2);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:3px;margin-bottom:10px}
.name{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:36px;letter-spacing:5px;line-height:1;margin-bottom:12px}
.name em{color:var(--accent);font-style:normal}
.bio{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted2);line-height:1.75;font-weight:300;max-width:280px;margin:0 auto}
.rule{height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(198,167,94,0.3),transparent);margin:24px 0}
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px;margin-bottom:28px}
.stat{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:13px 8px;text-align:center}
.stat-n{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:21px;color:var(--accent);letter-spacing:1px;display:block;margin-bottom:2px}
.stat-l{font-size:9px;color:#445;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1.5px}
.label{font-size:9px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:3px;color:#556;margin-bottom:10px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.label::after{content:'';flex:1;height:1px;background:var(--border)}
.cta{background:rgba(198,167,94,0.08);border:1px solid rgba(198,167,94,0.3);border-radius:14px;padding:20px;margin-bottom:28px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--text);transition:all 0.2s ease}
.cta:hover{background:rgba(198,167,94,0.12);border-color:rgba(198,167,94,0.5);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.cta-badge{background:var(--accent);color:#000;font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:2px;padding:2px 9px;border-radius:4px;margin-bottom:5px;display:inline-block}
.cta-icon{width:44px;height:44px;flex-shrink:0;background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:20px}
.cta-body{flex:1}
.cta-sub{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted2);font-weight:300}
.cta-arr{color:var(--accent);font-size:16px}
.links{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;margin-bottom:30px}
.link{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px;padding:13px 16px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:11px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--text);transition:all 0.2s ease}
.link:hover{background:var(--surface2);border-color:var(--border2);transform:translateX(2px)}
.link-icon{width:36px;height:36px;flex-shrink:0;background:#0a1830;border:1px solid var(--border2);border-radius:8px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.link-title{font-size:13px;font-weight:500;display:block}
.link-sub{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted2);font-weight:300;display:block;margin-top:1px}
.link-arr{color:#556;font-size:12px;margin-left:auto;transition:all 0.2s}
.link:hover .link-arr{color:var(--accent)}
.dot{display:inline-block;width:5px;height:5px;background:var(--green);border-radius:50%;margin-right:5px;vertical-align:middle;animation:blink 2s ease infinite}
@keyframes blink{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:0.25}}
.footer{text-align:center;font-size:10px;color:#223;letter-spacing:1.5px;text-transform:uppercase}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="wrap">
<div class="profile">
<div class="logo-wrap"><img class="logo-img" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Oskar Marketing"/></div>
<div class="handle">@oskarmarketing</div>
<div class="name">Oskar <em>Marketing</em></div>
<p class="bio">Ich zeige dir wie du mit Affiliate Marketing passives Einkommen aufbaust — ohne Produkt, ohne Startkapital.</p>
</div>
<div class="stats">
<div class="stat"><span class="stat-n">0€</span><span class="stat-l">Startkapital</span></div>
<div class="stat"><span class="stat-n">30</span><span class="stat-l">Tage System</span></div>
<div class="stat"><span class="stat-n">5-stlg</span><span class="stat-l">Monatsziel</span></div>
</div>
<div class="rule"></div>
<div class="label">Starte jetzt</div>
<a href="https://www.theaffiliateacademy.de" class="cta" target="_blank">
<div class="cta-icon">🚀</div>
<div class="cta-body"><div class="cta-badge">AFFILIATE ACADEMY</div><div class="cta-sub"><span class="dot"></span>Jetzt starten</div></div>
<div class="cta-arr">→</div>
</a>
<div class="rule"></div>
<div class="label">Folge mir</div>
<div class="links">
<a href="https://tiktok.com/@oskarmarketing" class="link" target="_blank">
<div class="link-icon"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="#f0f0f0"><path d="M19.59 6.69a4.83 4.83 0 01-3.77-4.25V2h-3.45v13.67a2.89 2.89 0 01-2.88 2.5 2.89 2.89 0 01-2.89-2.89 2.89 2.89 0 012.89-2.89c.28 0 .54.04.79.1V9.01a6.27 6.27 0 00-.79-.05 6.34 6.34 0 00-6.34 6.34 6.34 6.34 0 006.34 6.34 6.34 6.34 0 006.33-6.34V8.69a8.18 8.18 0 004.79 1.54V6.78a4.85 4.85 0 01-1.02-.09z"/></svg></div>
<div><span class="link-title">TikTok</span><span class="link-sub">Tägliche Tipps</span></div>
<span class="link-arr">→</span>
</a>
<a href="https://instagram.com/oskarmarketing" class="link" target="_blank">
<div class="link-icon"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#f0f0f0" stroke-width="2"><rect x="2" y="2" width="20" height="20" rx="5"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4"/><circle cx="17.5" cy="6.5" r="1" fill="#f0f0f0" stroke="none"/></svg></div>
<div><span class="link-title">Instagram</span><span class="link-sub">Behind the scenes & DMs</span></div>
<span class="link-arr">→</span>
</a>
<a href="https://youtube.com/@oskarmarketing" class="link" target="_blank">
<div class="link-icon"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="#f0f0f0"><path d="M23 7s-.3-2-1.2-2.8c-1.1-1.2-2.4-1.2-3-1.3C16.2 2.8 12 2.8 12 2.8s-4.2 0-6.8.2c-.6.1-1.9.1-3 1.3C1.3 5 1 7 1 7S.7 9.2.7 11.3v2c0 2.1.3 4.3.3 4.3s.3 2 1.2 2.8c1.1 1.2 2.6 1.1 3.3 1.2C7.2 21.8 12 21.8 12 21.8s4.2 0 6.8-.3c.6-.1 1.9-.1 3-1.3.9-.8 1.2-2.8 1.2-2.8s.3-2.1.3-4.3v-2C23.3 9.2 23 7 23 7zM9.7 15.5V8.3l8.1 3.6-8.1 3.6z"/></svg></div>
<div><span class="link-title">YouTube</span><span class="link-sub">Deep Dives</span></div>
<span class="link-arr">→</span>
</a>
</div>
<div class="footer">2026 Oskar Marketing</div>
</div>
</body>
</html>
